records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.34.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 af6df90d4f4cec81f5e2533d94eb81d1aeecf0f8eecf298cf4cabff0368f9f13, matching the digest GitHub reports
content:the package contains hooks/proposal_submit.py and commands/proposal-submit.md, and proposal_publication.py disables auto-maintenance for the snapshot fetch
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on 8ed378a, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
